items.label: Verify Patch cables under tabletop are connected to matching cables for away and home sides of the table

tasks.title: Away Bench Connection || Ports 1-2 (Events VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 1 to Panel Port 1 above switch
Connect long black cable labeled 'Switch-Away' to patch port 1 (left end of table) for away bench connection
Run 'Switch-Away' cable under bench seats next to scorers table
Place grey Cisco switch on floor under 2nd row bench and route cable underneath seat through the troth, and connect to switch port 1
Connect 3 4ft blue Ethernet cables to Cisco switch in ports 6-8
Using the fluke or testing laptop, verify connectivity: Away Bench IP - 172.32.x.x

tasks.title: Away Phone|| Ports 1-2 (Event's VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 2 to Panel Port 2 above switch
Connect visitor phone (check label under phone) using 6ft white ethernet cable
Place phone at end of table near away bench, check for dial tone and call the extension to make sure it rings

tasks.title: Tissot and Precision Time Whistle System (PTS) || Ports 3-10 (NBA VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Place Precisicion Time (PTS) to right of the Tissot machine
Direct connect Precision Time via a blue 4ft ethernet cable to Port 4 on switch
Connect black VGA cable to the back of the PTS and then to the corresponding connection on the Tissot machine in the whistle detection section
Connect brown XLR cable to the back of the PTS system and then to the corresponding connection on the Tissot machine in the whistle detection section
Connect Precision Time USB cable to back of precision time then run underneath table and connect to dasher wall port labeled 'PTS'
Connect power cable for Precision Time to the UPS battery next to the Tissot machine

tasks.title: Tracey's Laptop || Ports 3-10 (NBA VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 5 to Panel Port 23 above switch
On right side of table, directly connect Tracey's laptop to patch panel 23 using a labeled 6ft yellow ethernet cable
Plug in the black laptop charger to the outlet on table.
**IMPORTANT**: Leave Traceys laptop on the table only if there is a game happening that day. Otherwise place back in the closet bin until game days.

tasks.title: Sound Meter || Ports 11-20 (Event's VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Unpack mic, ethernet cord, power cable & mic cover from the carrying case, route under table, place in front of switch
Direct connect the sound meters black ethernet cable to Port 11 on switch
Place the mic stand in front of switch and make sure mic is secured in the stand with mic cover on the mic
Plug in power cord to table outlet
Direct Connect Statistician phone to port 12 (look for labeled ethernet cord) and place to the left of the monitor
Direct connect Security phone to port 13 (look for labeled ethernet cord) and place to the right of the monitor
Direct connect Tracey's phone (look for labeled ethernet cord)
Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 14 to Panel Port 20 above switch
Connect Tracey's phone to port D020 on the right side of table using 6ft labeled white ethernet cable

tasks.title: Tracey's Phone Light || Ports 11-20 (Event's VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 15 to Panel Port 21 above switch
Connect Traceys phone light to port D021 on the right side of table using 6ft labeled white ethernet cable

tasks.title: Phone Extensions || Ports 11-20 (Event's VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Dial all extensions to verify phones and phone light are working
Visiting Team: 2178; Scorers Table: 2120; Traceys Phone: 7503; NBA Security: 2167

tasks.title: Home Bench || Ports 21-22 (BBOPS's VLAN) || Switch Configuration

items.label: Using a purple jumper cable, patch switch Port 21 to Panel Port D024 above switch
Connect long black cable labeled 'Switch-Home' to patch port D024 (left end of table) for home bench connection
Run 'Switch-Home' cable under bench seats next to scorers table
Place grey Cisco switch on floor under 2nd row bench and route cable underneath seat through the troth, and connect to switch port 1
Connect 3 4ft grey Ethernet cables to Cisco switch in ports 6-8
Using the fluke or testing laptop, verify connectivity: Home Bench IP - 172.32.x.x
Connect 25ft orange ethernet cord labeled 'trunk' to port port 24 on switch, route it underneath the table and connect it to the dasher wall port labled 'NBA'
Plug in printer power cable directly into an outlet on table
Place printer on top of small black table in the closet.
Provide pack of paper and extra box of toner (850) and place on the tables bottom shelf.
Connect printer to laptop using grey USB cable.
After setup, Launch the NBA stats site on Chrome(website 10.111.24.29).
After launch, click the three bars on the top left and click print, select Box Score and cumulative to then print a test page.
PLace referee monitor in the am of the table holder. AV will handle the rest.
Power off all devices
Disconnect and coil all cables from the table equipment and switches. Disconnect all cables underneath the bench.
Return all items to labeled crates and cart in DVOM Closet
Confirm all cables and equipment are labeled and secured
Place switch under D-VOM riser section
Plug in switch for power
Connect trunk to port 38 on switch (using purple cable labeled 'D-VOM' from the closet)
Using purple cable from closet, connect one end of cord to the port on the piller underneath bleachers.
Run the labeled extended biscuit cables down from the tables and secure them.
Connect blue 4ft. ethernet cables to biscuits
Test all patch cables for internet connectivity using the fluke or tester laptop(they need to be able to access the web)
Disconnect switch and biscuit cables
Coil and store all cables
Return all items to labeled crates and cart in DVOM Closet

tasks.title: Setup Checklist || Deliver belt packs ~ 90 minutes before tip-off

items.label: Verify and take a picture of the game and referee names loaded on the PT screen(front table)
Using the picture, gather the corresponding referee packs from the bin in the IT office and replace the batteries. ALWAYS include an extra pack with fresh batteries in case of emergencies.
Record referee names on the back of the corresponding belt packs using tape and a silver ssharpie
Verify that there are two clips connected for each pack
Power on all belt packs
Confirm battery levels are fully green
Double check that power is on and deliver to referees/officers outside Officials room in D-VOM 90 minutes before the game. The extra pack stays at the D-VOM table
Collect all referee packs after the game
Power off referee packs.
Peel all tape from referee packs
Return all items to box in IT Office bin.
Equipment should be set up on the second table from right ONLY (when facing the court).
Place switch on top of table.
Connect switch to trunk port 16 under bleacher using blue Ethernet cable labeled 'trunk'(under bleacher)
Place laptops on table in this specific order from left to right: Secondary, Primary and PR
Using cables that have been ziptied (2 white cables and one green) connect to switch ports 1, 2, and 3
From switch port 1, direct connect to the Secondary Laptop
From switch port 2, direct connect to the Primary Laptop
From switch port 3, direct connect to the PR Laptop
Place UPS on table next to switch but behind the primary laptop
Plug all chargers into UPS and into the laptops
Connect black cable labled 'clock' to the Primary LT Ethernet via USB adapter
Place Replay monitor on table to the left of the switch
Connect the black power cable and bank to the power strips behind the monitor and power on the replay monitor
Connect keyboard, mouse, replay controller and ethernet cable (direct connect to port 4) to the back of the replay monitor.
Double-check peripheral function to make sure it works
Place RTS to the right of the switch and direct connect to port 5 yellow ethernet cable labeled 'RTS'
Connect phones using two 3ft green ethernet cables labled 'phones' to ports 10 and 11 on switch
Connect phone light to port 18 using a 3ft white ethernet cable labeled 'phone light'
Dial both extensions to verify phones and phone light are working
Provide 3 bricks (stats sets up) and 2 power cords to the furthest left table
Run 1 black Ethernet cord labeled 'bricks' to far end of tables to the left.
Run 1 blue ethernet cord labeled 'bricks' to far end of tables to the left.
Run 1 blue ethernet cord labeled 'bricks' to be placed directly to the left of the replay monitor.
Connect the blue power strip under bleacher(extension cord) labled 'Printer-EXT'
Connect USB printer Extension cable to the back of the PR laptop and connect to printer
Run both the blue power cord and the printer extenstion cord underneath the table and/or chair
Gaff both cables down to floor and make sure that they are not able to be snagged or tripped over
Provide a box of toner and a pack of paper and place it on the counter behind the printer'
On the PR laptop, go to settings and print a test page to verify printer is working properly
Power off and put away all laptops
Disconnect and coil all Ethernet and power cables.
Return switch, cables, gaff tape, radio bricks and devices to MC Quad D Closet
Test all biscuit connection for internet connectivity using the fluke or tester laptop(they need to be able to access the web)
leave 4 /biscuits to the right of table in section 108 free for social media ethernet cables (they will plug them in).
Place request forms for the 6ft Pink Ethernet cables in all of the corresponding sections
Collect all cables at the end of the game
Call 201-974-6917 for system test
Test game clock, stats radio and headset
label chanel for stats radio
Print sample stats page
Complete NBA Form linked on physical instructions
Verify Every Cubicle is on EVENT VLAN with internet connection
Verify Netgear switch is powered on and connected to EVENT VLAN
Verify stats computer is connected to NBA VLAN
Verify phone is powered on and has a dial tone
Verify stats phone is connected to NBA VLAN
Verify trucks have internet and stats feeds
Verify power and network connectivity
Setup Zoom Carts
Hang NBA backdrop
Setup extra monitor, keyboard, microphone, mic stand, and mouse on table
